encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.note: Pollux 10, 176 ὁλκεῖον, ἀγγεῖον ὑγρῶν τε καὶ ξηρῶν ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολὺ χαλκοῦν, ὡς . . . ἐν Φιλήμονος Γάμῳ κτλ.

lg.l: ἐν Καρὶ τὸν κίνδυνον· οἶδα, δέσποτα.

div.note: Schol. Platonis 322 Bekk. ἐν τῷ Καρὶ ὑμῖν ὁ κίνδυνος . . . Φιλήμων ἐν Γάμῳ κτλ.
B. οἶδα Cobet. N. 1. 22. non opus. servus animadvertens fore ut erus ipsum in discrimen committat ‘in me’ inquit ‘periculum facere statuisti; scio, domine’. cf. Cratin. 16.
Bekker. Anecd. 92, 16 ἐμὲ ἀντὶ τοῦ ἐμαυτόν, σὲ ἀντὶ τοῦ σαυτόν.
div.p: Φιλήμων Γαμοῦντι· σώζε σαυτόν, ἐγὼ δ’ ἐμέ. fortasse Γάμῳ· οὐκοῦν σὺ σῷζε σαυτόν, | ἐγὼ δ’ ἐμέ, ut sint tetrametri iambici. ac σὺ iam Herwerd. Mnem. nov. VI 73.

div.note: Bekker. Anecd. 99, 24 θρασέα· Φιλήμων Γάμῳ· θρ. γυνή. Γάλλῳ et θρασεῖα cod.
— fortasse Θρασέα, i. e. Thraseae uxor, quod nomen in titulis haud rarum est. cf. Roehl. Ind. C. I.
